# Chart values

For: admins who install githubgate with its Helm chart.

<!-- Generated by `make generate` from deploy/charts/githubgate/values.yaml. Do not edit. -->

| Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `replicas` | `3` | Number of server replicas. Every replica serves requests. |
| `image.repository` | `ghcr.io/soliddowant/githubgate` | Server image repository. |
| `image.digest` | `""` | Image digest (`sha256:...`). When set, the image is pinned by digest and the tag is ignored. Set it in production. |
| `image.tag` | `""` | Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion. Used only when no digest is set. |
| `image.pullPolicy` | `IfNotPresent` | Image pull policy. |
| `imagePullSecrets` | `[]` | Names of image pull Secrets. |
| `nameOverride` | `""` | Override the chart name used in resource names. |
| `fullnameOverride` | `""` | Override the full resource name. |
| `adminNamespaces` | `[]` | Namespaces that may hold GitHubApp and GitHubInstallation objects, and whose Secrets githubgate may read. Defaults to the release namespace. |
| `githubBaseURL` | `""` | GitHub REST API root. Empty means api.github.com. Set it for GitHub Enterprise Server or a test double. |
| `webhook.enabled` | `false` | Serve the validating admission webhook (needs cert-manager). |
| `webhook.failurePolicy` | `Fail` | What the API server does when the webhook is unreachable. |
| `proxy.enabled` | `false` | Serve proxy mode: a second TLS listener behind the `githubgate-proxy` Service (port 443). Needs cert-manager and `proxy.ca`. |
| `proxy.clusterIP` | `""` | Fixed cluster IP of the `githubgate-proxy` Service, so pods can name it in `hostAliases`. Empty means the cluster picks one. |
| `proxy.ca.name` | `""` | Name of the cert-manager Issuer or ClusterIssuer that signs the proxy certificate. Use the admin's name-constrained CA (permitted subtree `github.com`). Required when `proxy.enabled` is true. |
| `proxy.ca.kind` | `Issuer` | Kind of the issuer. |
| `proxy.ca.group` | `cert-manager.io` | API group of the issuer. |
| `certificate.caConfigMapName` | `githubgate-ca` | Name of the ConfigMap that publishes the CA for clients. |
| `certificate.caDurationDays` | `3650` | Validity of the generated CA, in days. |
| `certificate.duration` | `2160h` | Validity of the serving certificates. |
| `certificate.renewBefore` | `720h` | How long before expiry cert-manager renews the serving certificates. |
| `podDisruptionBudget.enabled` | `true` | Create a PodDisruptionBudget. |
| `podDisruptionBudget.maxUnavailable` | `1` | Pods that may be down at once. |
| `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` | `30` | Seconds githubgate has to shut down. |
| `serviceMonitor.enabled` | `false` | Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor. |
| `serviceMonitor.interval` | `30s` | Scrape interval. |
| `crds.install` | `true` | Install the CRDs with the chart. Set to false when you manage them yourself. |
| `serviceAccount.create` | `true` | Create the ServiceAccount. |
| `serviceAccount.name` | `""` | ServiceAccount name. Defaults to the full name. |
| `serviceAccount.annotations` | `{}` | Annotations for the ServiceAccount. |
| `resources.requests.cpu` | `100m` | CPU request. There is no CPU limit. |
| `resources.requests.memory` | `128Mi` | Memory request. |
| `resources.limits.memory` | `128Mi` | Memory limit. Keep it equal to the memory request. |
| `podSecurityContext.runAsNonRoot` | `true` | Run the pod as a non-root user. |
| `podSecurityContext.runAsUser` | `65532` | User ID of the pod (the distroless nonroot user). |
| `podSecurityContext.runAsGroup` | `65532` | Group ID of the pod. |
| `podSecurityContext.seccompProfile.type` | `RuntimeDefault` | Seccomp profile of the pod. |
| `securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation` | `false` | Allow privilege escalation in the container. |
| `securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem` | `true` | Mount the container's root filesystem read-only. |
| `securityContext.capabilities.drop` | `["ALL"]` | Linux capabilities dropped from the container. |
| `podAnnotations` | `{}` | Pod annotations. |
| `nodeSelector` | `{}` | Node selector. |
| `tolerations` | `[]` | Tolerations. |
| `affinity` | `{}` | Affinity rules. |
